name: GEOG 4001W
title: Writing in Geography
description: Techniques for, and practice in, research, writing, citation, and data presentation in geography.
requirement_description: One Geography course at the 2000 level or higher; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to junior or higher Geography and GIS majors. Corequisite: One Geography course at the 3000 level or higher.
